message:
fix: don't log a missing-author error for the reserved system author (#8044) (#8090)

Every pad created with non-empty initial text and no explicit authorId --
which includes every pad that gets the default `settings.defaultPadText`
welcome content since #7885 -- carries `a.etherpad-system` in its
attribute pool forever. The system author is changeset bookkeeping, not a
contributor, and deliberately has no `globalAuthor:` record, but
CLIENT_READY resolved every pool author as if it were a real one and
logged

  [ERROR] message - There is no author for authorId: a.etherpad-system.

on every single pad open, for new and pre-existing pads alike.

Filter the system author out of the historicalAuthorData lookup, the same
way `listAuthorsOfPad` already keeps it out of the public API. Nothing
else changes: the id was never present in historicalAuthorData (the
lookup failed), so clients see exactly what they saw before.

While here, the id had been duplicated as a bare literal in five modules
(each with a comment explaining that importing `Pad.SYSTEM_AUTHOR_ID`
would be a circular require). Move the canonical definition into a leaf
module, `src/node/utils/SystemAuthor.ts`, and import it everywhere;
`Pad.SYSTEM_AUTHOR_ID` stays as a re-export for plugin compatibility.

Adds a backend regression test that fails on the pre-fix code.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
